paper_title: SepLLM Accelerate Large Language Models by Compressing One Segment into   One Separator
caption: Training loss curves for the post-training setting.

The plot illustrates training loss values over iterations. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration," using a linear scale with a range from 95000 to 125000, and tick labels are displayed every 10000 iterations. The y-axis is labeled "Loss," using a linear scale with a range from 2.0 to 3.0. A red, dashed line with no markers represents "Vanilla before post-training," and remains constant at a value of 2.3 across the entire x-axis range. A blue line with circular markers depicts "SepLLM (n=128)," starting at approximately 2.94 at 95000 iterations and declining to approximately 2.22 at 125000 iterations. An orange line with triangular markers shows "SepLLM (n=64)," beginning at approximately 2.96 at 95000 iterations and decreasing to about 2.23 at 125000 iterations. A magenta line with diamond markers represents "SepLLM (n=64, larger lr)," which starts at approximately 2.95 at 95000 iterations and descends to roughly 2.22 at 125000 iterations.
